subject: Post-call: Finova throughput & streaming test coordination
messages:
From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Duarte <alex.duarte@finova.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Finova throughput & streaming test coordination

Hi Alex — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the customer-led test window: 

Recap of targets you stated on the call:
- Concurrent streaming sessions: target 300 sustained sessions (with spikes to 450 for short bursts)
- Aggregate throughput: ~250 requests/sec (mix of single-turn and streaming)
- Latency goals: 95th perc <= 220 ms for single-turn generation; streaming chunk latency target < 120 ms per chunk
- Payloads: median prompt length ~180 tokens; max session length ~2k tokens

What we need from you to proceed:
1) Confirm a 3-hour test window (we suggested Tue 2027-08-10 02:00–05:00 UTC) or propose an alternate window
2) Confirm IPs or CIDRs to allowlist (we'll provide a template)
3) Provide any sample prompt sets you want in the k6 script, or we can use the example dataset attached
4) Confirm whether you want per-tenant test accounts or a single shared test account

Attachments: I attached a starter k6 profile (finova_k6_profile_v1.js), an ip_allowlist_template.csv, and a sample metrics dashboard snapshot so you can see what we'll capture.

Next steps / owners:
- Alex: confirm window + allowlist + test-account preference
- Marissa: coordinate calendar invite & commercial checklist
- Marcus / Soojin: we'll provision test keys, prepare routing that matches your prod config, and set up dashboards

If that looks good I can provision the test account and share credentials via the secure portal once we have the allowlist.

Thanks — talk soon.

—Laura Bennett
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0142
From: Alex Duarte <alex.duarte@finova.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@finova.com
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 18:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Finova throughput & streaming test coordination

Laura — thanks for the summary and the attachments. Confirming the numbers from our side, and a couple clarifications: 

- The goal is 300 sustained concurrent streams with up to 450 bursts, agreed.
- Throughput mix: roughly 60% streaming sessions, 40% single-turn generation.
- Latency: your proposed 95th <= 220 ms single-turn is fine; streaming chunk target < 120 ms is ideal. For p99 we expect to track but won't hold the platform to a hard SLA during the test.

Window: Tue 2027-08-10 02:00–05:00 UTC works for our engineering team.
Allowlist: we'll provide an allowlist of our load drivers and CI agents. Attaching the initial set now (ops@finova will send CSV to the allowlist template).
Account: prefer a single test account with scoped limits and per-test run labels so we can correlate metrics.

One ask: we have a downstream router that uses checkpointed KV cache behavior — can Marcus confirm whether Redwood's test routing will mimic the same KV cache hit distribution?

I'll wait for the calendar invite.

—Alex
Alex Duarte, Engineering Manager — Platform
Finova Labs
From: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Duarte <alex.duarte@finova.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 01:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Finova throughput & streaming test coordination

On Mon, 2 Aug 2027 at 18:02 -0700, Alex Duarte <alex.duarte@finova.com> wrote:
> One ask: we have a downstream router that uses checkpointed KV cache behavior — can Marcus confirm whether Redwood's test routing will mimic the same KV cache hit distribution?

Hi Alex — short answer: yes, we can mirror cache behavior for the test. Details below and a few configuration questions so we match your prod charactistics: 

What we'll mirror:
- KV cache warmup: we can pre-populate KV entries based on a seed set you provide (recommended)
- Affinity: test routing will keep tokens for the same session on a single worker to emulate live session locality
- Cache hit distribution: we can configure a hit ratio target; please indicate approximate hit ratio (e.g., 65% cache hit) 

Technical:
- We'll provision a scoped test API key: scope=streaming,quota=500k tokens for the test window; keys delivered via secure portal.
- IPs to allowlist: our test runners will come from these CIDRs: 34.72.128.0/20, 35.196.64.0/19 (we also support adding your CI agent IPs) — please append your agents to the ip_allowlist_template.csv and return.
- k6 script: the attached finova_k6_profile_v1.js has two scenarios: streamingScenario and singleTurnScenario. It uses chunked streaming with small chunk sizes to emulate interactive typing.

Metrics we'll push to the dashboard during the run: token/sec, requests/sec, 50/95/99 latencies (per-chunk and end-to-end), concurrency, error rate, and KV cache hit ratio. We'll also capture per-model cost estimation so you can review unit economics.

If you can share a small seed dataset (100 representative prompts) we will preload KV and warm caches for a 30-min warmup prior to the window.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin | Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Duarte <alex.duarte@finova.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 07:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Finova throughput & streaming test coordination

Thanks both — locking the window Tue 2027-08-10 02:00–05:00 UTC. Marissa will send the invite and the pre-test checklist.

Action items (final):
- Alex / Finova: return ip_allowlist_template.csv with your CI/load-driver CIDRs and the 100-prompt seed set (deadline: 2027-08-07 23:59 UTC)
- Marcus / Redwood infra: provision test key and routing, pre-warm KV, post-run metrics snapshot
- Marissa / AE: confirm cost estimate and any contract notes for the test (we won't bill the initial rehearsal)

I'll send credentials via the secure portal once the allowlist is confirmed.

—Laura
From: Alex Duarte <alex.duarte@finova.com>
To: laura.bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Finova throughput & streaming test coordination

Perfect — I uploaded the allowlist CSV to your template and shared the 100-prompt seed set in the Drive link. One note: please create a single test API key and mark runs with header X-Finova-Run-ID so we can separate runs in our telemetry.

We'll have two engineers on the call during the run: Priya N. and Jonah R. — they'll coordinate with Marcus for any live troubleshooting.

See you on the 10th.

—Alex
Alex Duarte, Finova Labs
